_notes: output = floor(Spell Power x Mult) of the cast word (see GDD 4.4).
critLength counts letters AND [ ! ] tiles; commas are not counted.
A weapon can be cast any number of times per turn while Energy remains.
source 'unused' = implemented but not obtainable in the current build.

weapons.name: Wand
weapons.critEffect: Inflict Broken 2 on the target (+50% damage taken).

weapons.name: Flame Lance
weapons.formula: damage = output to target (crit: same damage to every enemy)

weapons.name: War Drum
weapons.effect: Gain Might equal to output ÷ 5 (min 1). Might adds Spell Power to every attack this combat.

weapons.name: Mirror Ward
weapons.critEffect: Gain Thorns equal to half the Shield: every enemy that attacks you takes that much damage.

weapons.name: Venom Quill
weapons.effect: Inflict Poison equal to output ÷ 3 (min 1). Poison deals its stacks at the end of each enemy turn, then drops by 1.
weapons.formula: poison = max(1, floor(output/3)) on target (crit: all enemies)

weapons.name: Seeker's Lantern
weapons.critEffect: The drawn tiles become Level 2 for this combat.

weapons.name: Rune Chisel
weapons.effect: Carve Fragile copies of the word's LAST letter into your hand: 1 per 8 output (min 1, max 3). Fragile tiles vanish after one use. If your hand is full (16), they go to your discard pile.
weapons.formula: create min(3, max(1, floor(output/8))) Fragile copies of the word's last letter in hand

weapons.name: Cleansing Bell
weapons.effect: Remove every debuff from the tiles in your hand, and gain Shield equal to output ÷ 2.
weapons.critEffect: Also remove all of YOUR debuffs (Poison, Weaken, Broken, Frustrated, Curse).

weapons.name: Sand Hourglass
weapons.effect: Store time: next turn you get +1 Energy, +1 more per 12 output (max +3).
weapons.critEffect: Next turn you also draw 3 extra tiles.

weapons.name: Boomerang
weapons.effect: Deal damage. The tiles you used fly back into your hand. Your hand holds at most 16 tiles; extra tiles you would draw are discarded.
weapons.critEffect: It hits a second time for half damage.
weapons.formula: damage = output; used tiles return to hand (crit: second hit floor(damage/2))

weapons.name: Greatsword
weapons.effect: Deal damage. Each swing costs you 3 HP.
weapons.critEffect: +1 Spell Power for every 2 HP you are missing.
weapons.formula: damage = output; self-damage 3 HP per cast

weapons.name: Dumbbell
weapons.effect: Gain Might equal to output × 0.1 (rounded down, min 1).
weapons.critEffect: Heal HP equal to 2 × your Might.

weapons.name: Parrying Dagger
weapons.critEffect: Also gain Shield equal to the output.

weapons.name: Utility Belt
weapons.effect: Forge Fragile [ ! ] tiles into your discard pile: 1 per 8 output (min 1, max 3). Put ! at the end of a word for bonus Spell Power.
weapons.formula: forge floor(output/8) Fragile [!] tiles (min 1, max 3) into discard pile
